Add `_filterExtractedString:options:completionHandler:` on `WKWebView`, which applies text extraction filters to an arbitrary string without requiring a debug text extraction. Filter rules are lazily fetched and installed on first use, and a shared private helper avoids duplicating this rule-loading logic with the existing extraction path.     #### f293be74293ad8fe8fe9cf323e45001004ae858b Use a transparency layer instead of a CGLayer for gradients with shadows https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=328585 rdar://190779264 Reviewed by Said Abou-Hallawa. GraphicsContextCG paints gradients that have a drop shadow into a CGLayer, then draws the layer with the shadow applied.
